service.description: Purge old LLM call logs, messages, and conversations. Messages first so the LlmMessage FK to LlmConversation is not violated.

actions.script: import org.moqui.context.ExecutionContext import org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition ExecutionContext ec = context.ec Calendar basisCal = ec.user.getCalendarSafe() basisCal.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, (int) -daysToKeep) basisTimestamp = new Timestamp(basisCal.getTimeInMillis()) // Delete children of old conversations first so the LlmMessage FK cannot fail the job. def oldConvs = ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmConversation") .condition("lastMessageDate", EntityCondition.LESS_THAN, basisTimestamp) .disableAuthz().list() def oldIds = oldConvs.collect { it.conversationId }.findAll { it } callLogsRemoved = 0L messagesRemoved = 0L conversationsRemoved = 0L if (oldIds) { callLogsRemoved += ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmCallLog") .condition("conversationId", EntityCondition.IN, oldIds) .disableAuthz().deleteAll() messagesRemoved += ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmMessage") .condition("conversationId", EntityCondition.IN, oldIds) .disableAuthz().deleteAll() conversationsRemoved += ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmConversation") .condition("conversationId", EntityCondition.IN, oldIds) .disableAuthz().deleteAll() } messagesRemoved += ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmMessage") .condition("sentDate", EntityCondition.LESS_THAN, basisTimestamp) .disableAuthz().deleteAll() callLogsRemoved += ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmCallLog") .condition("startDate", EntityCondition.LESS_THAN, basisTimestamp) .disableAuthz().deleteAll() ec.logger.info("Removed ${callLogsRemoved} LlmCallLog, ${messagesRemoved} LlmMessage, ${conversationsRemoved} LlmConversation records more than ${daysToKeep} days old")

service.description: New LLM turn (sync JSON). Use POST /llm/v1/chat for SSE.

actions.script: def result = org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmGateway.chat(ec, context) if (result) context.putAll(result)

service.description: Post client tool results and continue the agent loop (sync).

actions.script: def result = org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmGateway.resume(ec, context) if (result) context.putAll(result)
